description: This file provides polyfill implementations for ctype functions in PHP, specifically for environments where these functions are not available. It redefines functions like ctype_alnum, ctype_alpha, etc., by delegating calls to the Symfony Polyfill Ctype class.

classes.name: p\Ctype
classes.description: Namespace class providing static methods for Ctype checks, used as fallback implementations.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if the input is alphanumeric, delegating to Symfony's Ctype class.

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only alphabetic characters.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if the input contains control characters.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only digits.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if the input contains any printable character except space.

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only lowercase characters.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only printable characters.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if the input contains punctuation characters.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only whitespace.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only uppercase characters.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only hexadecimal digit characters.
